# Iterate over all markdown files in the directory
for file_path in directory_listing:
    # Extract filename and derive title
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    if not filename.endswith('.md'):
        continue
    title = filename[:-3].replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Skip if note already exists
    if title in existing_titles:
        print(f"Skipping {title} (already exists)")
        continue
    
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_data['content']

    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {title}: {result}")
    existing_titles.add(title)
